arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort from pod reserve. My jobs: (1) keep pod honest: compare pod power with heart rate and with GPS speed per direction; set pod_gain if pod drifts; (2) weed/drag: local push falling within a leg -> clear_rudder if pacer has not; (3) course/radio changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (4) CP check from HR trend at steady effort (HR climbing = above CP). Use legs() to compare same-direction legs. Few cues, only when useful.
